primary.entity: TV stand / cabinet under the television
primary.what: The same living-room corner (TV beneath the wall clock, hallway at right) has the TV standing on a white cabinet with drawers in Shot2 but on a dark wood/black stand flanked by black set-top boxes in Shot5.

secondary.what: The wall behind the clock and TV is off-white/light gray in Shot2 but beige in Shot5.
His top changes from a blue crew-neck long-sleeved sweater (Shot1) to a V-neck T-shirt (Shot3), a collared button-down dress shirt (Shot4) and a short-sleeved navy polo (Shot6).
The reddish-brown beard and slim build of Shot3/Shot4 become a gray-white beard and a much heavier build in Shot6.
Her face and hair differ between Shot2 (older round face, wavy layered bob) and Shot5 (younger angular face, straight bob).
The hallway has a pale square-tile floor in Shot1, but the hallway seen through the doorway in Shot5 f5 has a wood plank floor.

unspecified_seen: TV stand/cabinet (Shot2 white, Shot5 dark with set-top boxes), small framed pictures in the hallway (Shot1; one in the hallway view of Shot5), patio table with items among the outdoor chairs (Shot6 only), trees/greenery through windows and outdoors (Shot1, Shot4, Shot6), laundry inside the basket (blue clothes in Shot4, unclear in Shot1), light switches (Shot1, Shot2); only the TV stand clearly recurs across shots.
